combo_label: At the Vet's × The Blacksmith's Forge × Castles & Medieval Life

entries.clue: Poet's word for a fine spirited horse, the sort heroes ride in old romances
A tap of the sword on each shoulder raised a man to this mounted rank
Paired organ whose slow failure carries off so many elderly cats
Stone privy set in a wall's thickness, its shaft dropping to the ditch
Certificate of breeding that lists the generations behind a dog
Nipping tool with two crossed jaws, used to draw a nail out
Great tower at the heart of a stronghold, the last refuge once the walls were lost
Last live coal in a grate, still red under its coat of ash
Rounded end of a hammer head, opposite the flat striking face
Slim handle and a throwaway blade, peeled from a sterile pack
